harness_setup_install_preview: अपने कंप्यूटर पर {agent} डाउनलोड और इंस्टॉल करने के लिए नीचे दी गई कमांड को स्वीकार करें।
harness_setup_update_preview: अपने कंप्यूटर पर {agent} अपडेट करने के लिए नीचे दी गई कमांड को स्वीकार करें।
growth_no_products: अभी तक कोई उत्पाद आयात नहीं हुआ है।
growth_intro_body: एजेंटों को उत्पाद का वही संदर्भ दें। क्या जारी करना है चुनने से पहले उनके कार्यान्वयन, जांच और समझौतों की तुलना करें।
growth_demo_title: काल्पनिक उत्पाद पर एक बैटल आज़माएं।
growth_demo_body: तीन बंडल प्रस्ताव अलग worktree में वास्तविक बदलाव करते हैं। जांच देखें, जिसमें एक जानबूझकर शीर्षक विफलता शामिल है। प्रस्ताव सिम्युलेटेड हैं; वृद्धि के परिणाम अभी परीक्षणित नहीं हैं।
growth_candidate_earns_place: उम्मीदवार को अपनी जगह अर्जित करनी होगी।
growth_connection_connecting: स्थानीय अपडेट से जुड़ रहा है
growth_measure_intro: इस ब्राउज़र में अपनी CSV पढ़ें। GrowthLab हर मेट्रिक और वैकल्पिक वितरण या चैनल के भीतर वैरिएंट की तुलना स्थानीय रूप से करता है और किसी प्रदाता को पंक्तियाँ नहीं भेजता।
growth_measure_loading_sources: स्रोत उपलब्धता लोड हो रही है…
growth_measure_sources_unavailable: स्रोत उपलब्धता लोड नहीं हो सकी; स्थानीय CSV इस ब्राउज़र में उपलब्ध है।
growth_measure_loaded_locally: स्थानीय रूप से लोड किया गया:
growth_measure_analysis_summary: अन्वेषणात्मक अंतराल कैसे काम करते हैं
growth_measure_analysis_body: स्वतंत्र अवलोकनों पर 95% सामान्य सन्निकटन। माध्य अंतराल के लिए समूह में कम से कम दो पंक्तियाँ चाहिए; अंतर अंतराल के लिए बेसलाइन और वैरिएंट दोनों में कम से कम दो पंक्तियाँ चाहिए। ये अंतराल वर्णनात्मक हैं और महत्व, कारण या विजेता सिद्ध नहीं करते।
growth_measure_limit: आपकी फ़ाइल से मापा गया; कारण, महत्व या वृद्धि का अनुमान नहीं लगाया गया है.
growth_settings_intro: इस स्थानीय डैशबोर्ड की भाषा और थीम चुनें। ये पसंद ब्राउज़र में रहती हैं और उत्पाद फ़ाइलों को नहीं बदलतीं।
growth_settings_privacy_body: उत्पाद संदर्भ, बैटल प्रमाण और CSV पंक्तियाँ इसी मशीन पर रहती हैं, जब तक आप बाहरी एकीकरण न चुनें।
growth_settings_integrations_body: स्रोत रजिस्ट्री बताती है कि आगे क्या जोड़ा जा सकता है। नियोजित प्रदाता आपके कॉन्फ़िगर और अधिकृत करने तक निष्क्रिय रहते हैं।
growth_settings_contract_intro: एजेंटों को मिलने वाले उत्पाद तथ्यों, अनुमतियों और जाँचों की समीक्षा करें।
growth_settings_contract_empty: स्थिर अनुबंध देखने के लिए कोई उत्पाद वर्कस्पेस चुनें। स्थानीय वर्कस्पेस यहाँ सूचीबद्ध हैं।
growth_battle_no_eligible: अभी कोई योग्य सीलबंद उम्मीदवार नहीं
growth_battle_selection_review: चयन समीक्षा का निर्णय है। सफल कमांड रूपांतरण बढ़ने का प्रमाण नहीं हैं।
growth_battle_report_body: इसमें जाँच, डाइजेस्ट और स्रोत शामिल हैं। निजी उत्पाद नाम, पथ, प्रॉम्प्ट और कच्चे लॉग डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से छिपे रहते हैं।
growth_battle_inspect_diff: डिफ़ और कैप्चर किए गए लॉग देखें →
growth_rubric_no_gaps: इस स्थानीय समीक्षा में कोई कमी नहीं मिली।
growth_rubric_no_structural_gaps: इस स्थानीय रूब्रिक में कोई संरचनात्मक कमी नहीं मिली।
growth_static_preview_evidence_failed: साक्ष्य सत्यापन विफल हुआ। संग्रह सत्यापित होने तक पूर्वावलोकन उपलब्ध नहीं है।
growth_static_preview_no_archive: इस प्रयास के लिए अभी संग्रहीत स्थिर पूर्वावलोकन नहीं है। पिछले रन संग्रह अपरिवर्तित हैं।

growth_identity_evidence_fixed: Identity, role and evidence stay fixed.
growth_no_hypotheses: No hypotheses yet. Create the starter map, then choose one branch for a focused battle.
growth_no_battles: Prepare your first battle to see the shared contract and competing variants.
growth_inspect_progress: Inspect captured progress while the controller works.
growth_review_evidence: Review the evidence before selecting a candidate.
growth_command_registered: Command {index} is registered. Its captured log appears in the artifact viewer as the checkpoint advances.
growth_artifacts_before_checkpoint: Artifacts appear after the first recorded checkpoint. No execution has been fabricated.
growth_no_checkpoint_artifacts: This checkpoint has no viewer artifacts yet.
growth_review_exact_change: Preview the exact change before modifying your product working tree.
growth_apply_consent: Apply only this selected variant to my product working tree. I will review and commit the changes myself.
growth_os_validation_unavailable: OS validation isolation is unavailable on this host. Demo execution is refused.
growth_about_foundation: Built from OpenResearch's open-source foundation. MIT licensed; no alphaXiv endorsement.
growth_alpha_pending: Native execution, broader evaluators, the bundled visual demo and release packaging are still in progress.
growth_import_description: Use a reviewed growthlab.yaml. Import records the brief and baseline without publishing your product.
growth_initialize_git_snapshot: Initialize a local Git snapshot if this folder is not already a repository.
growth_manual_brief_description: Describe the product and the outcome you want to improve. GrowthLab creates a private local analysis workspace with no provider request and no publication.
growth_status_simulated_detail: Declared replay proposals; real edits still execute.
growth_status_observed_detail: Actual configured checks and their exit codes.
growth_status_untested_detail: Growth outcomes until real telemetry is supplied.
growth_configuration_help_intro: Run growthlab init --help in your product, choose permissions and validation commands, then review growthlab.yaml.
growth_configuration_help_policy: With the option enabled, GrowthLab stages the folder, rejects protected paths such as credentials and .env, creates one local commit and configures no remote. Existing repositories are never auto-committed.
growth_principles_body: File changes run in isolated worktrees. Validation runs on recorded candidate snapshots. Every finished attempt is sealed for inspection.
growth_page_heading: Review one page before you write more.
growth_page_body: Paste a public HTTPS page to get an inspectable structural SEO review. GrowthLab checks robots.txt, makes one read-only request and never claims rankings or conversions.
growth_retrieved_page_summary: Retrieved {date} · one page request · no credentials or redirects
growth_repository_body: Check the public description, branch and license before deciding what product context to bring locally. GrowthLab reads one GitHub metadata response; it never clones or runs source code until you explicitly choose a new local destination.
growth_repository_response_summary: One metadata response · source files were not fetched · no workspace was created.
growth_import_repository_local: Import this repository into a new local folder
growth_repository_import_body: The destination must not already exist. If the repository has no growthlab.yaml, provide the three brief fields below; the contract is committed only to your local clone.
growth_repository_product_name: Product name (only for a checkout without growthlab.yaml)
growth_new_contract_permission_mode: Permission mode for a new contract
growth_playbook_body: Use one clear role at a time: ask better questions, collect evidence, and keep the next experiment within your product's boundaries.
growth_saved_local_role: Saved locally as an UNTESTED role contract; no provider or outcome claim.
growth_reusable_template: A reusable template; no provider request or outcome claim.
growth_check_api_or_workspaces: Check the local API error or return to product workspaces.
growth_execution_contract: Every strategy follows this frozen contract. Changes stay in isolated worktrees; configured checks run under OS restrictions.
growth_isolation_unavailable: Validation isolation is unavailable on this host. Execution is refused.
growth_replay_json_plan: Replay JSON plan (schema v1, three implementations)
growth_replay_too_large: Replay file must be at most 1 MiB.
growth_replay_description: The replay declares proposals only. File edits, commits, validation and archives execute in Rust. No outcome data is simulated into a measured result.
growth_provider_consent: Authorize this harness to send the allowed product files, goal and frozen contract to its provider for tools-disabled proposals.
growth_native_unverified: Adapter capability does not verify installation or authentication. Native execution remains unverified in this alpha; unavailable CLIs produce honest failed attempts.
growth_check_calculation_fallback: Passed configured commands / required commands. Eligibility additionally requires a successful sealed run, the exact frozen command list and one immutable candidate commit. This is not a growth score.
growth_export_notice: Selected patch exported. The product working tree was preserved.
growth_apply_notice: Selected changes applied to the working tree. Product HEAD, index and remotes were preserved.
growth_footer_brand: Built with GrowthLab · local-first, open source
growth_footer_limits: Command checks ≠ measured growth. Runtime files are trusted inputs; resource quotas are not provided.
growth_playbook_strategist_summary: Turn a broad growth goal into a small set of testable levers and a clear decision rule
growth_playbook_strategist_question_1: What outcome matters now, and which audience is in scope?
growth_playbook_strategist_question_2: Which product surface can change without widening permissions?
growth_playbook_strategist_question_3: What would make this test useful even if the result is inconclusive?
growth_playbook_strategist_output_2: Hypothesis tree with parent and child questions
growth_playbook_strategist_output_3: Primary metric, guardrails and decision rule
growth_playbook_strategist_guardrail_1: Use only the committed product brief and user-supplied evidence.
growth_playbook_strategist_guardrail_2: Do not present a proxy score as conversion, revenue or ranking evidence.
growth_playbook_researcher_focus: Collect permitted facts before proposing copy
growth_playbook_researcher_summary: Separate product facts, primary sources and model inference so a growth claim can be checked
growth_playbook_researcher_question_1: Which claim is directly supported by the product or a primary source?
growth_playbook_researcher_question_2: What source date, publisher and limitation should be recorded?
growth_playbook_researcher_question_3: Which missing fact would most change the proposed experiment?
growth_playbook_researcher_guardrail_1: Respect robots.txt, terms, rate limits and access boundaries.
growth_playbook_researcher_guardrail_2: Never invent customer quotes, market size or competitor facts.
growth_playbook_positioning_focus: Make the product's value easy to understand
growth_playbook_positioning_summary: Compare outcome-led, pain-led and audience-specific messages using facts the product can support
growth_playbook_positioning_question_1: Who is the intended visitor and what job are they trying to finish?
growth_playbook_positioning_question_2: What concrete outcome can the product demonstrate today?
growth_playbook_positioning_question_3: Which words could overpromise capability or certainty?
growth_playbook_positioning_output_2: Headline, supporting proof and call-to-action variants
growth_playbook_positioning_output_3: Claim checklist tied to product evidence
growth_playbook_positioning_guardrail_1: Do not add testimonials, logos or results without supplied evidence.
growth_playbook_positioning_guardrail_2: Keep the original product safe until a user selects a change.
growth_playbook_conversion_focus: Remove uncertainty before the first action
growth_playbook_conversion_summary: Improve landing-page hierarchy and calls to action while preserving a transparent, reversible review path
growth_playbook_conversion_question_1: What is the first useful action for a qualified visitor?
growth_playbook_conversion_question_2: What proof can be inspected without a hidden or external dependency?
growth_playbook_conversion_question_3: Which friction is observable in the current page or flow?
growth_playbook_conversion_guardrail_1: No dark patterns, forced consent or deceptive urgency.
growth_playbook_conversion_guardrail_2: Do not claim a conversion lift before real telemetry is connected.
growth_playbook_seo_focus: Match useful pages to real search intent
growth_playbook_seo_summary: Find evidence-backed page opportunities and improve on-page clarity without spam or ranking promises
growth_playbook_seo_question_1: What question can the product answer better than a generic page?
growth_playbook_seo_question_2: Which supplied facts support the title, headings and description?
growth_playbook_seo_question_3: What would make the page useful after the visitor arrives from search?
growth_playbook_seo_output_2: Title, description, heading and internal-link suggestions
growth_playbook_seo_output_3: Local structural audit with next steps
growth_playbook_seo_guardrail_1: No keyword stuffing, doorway pages, scraped copy or guaranteed rankings.
growth_playbook_seo_guardrail_2: Label rubric output ESTIMATED and keep real traffic MEASURED only from user data.
growth_playbook_onboarding_focus: Shorten the path to first value
growth_playbook_onboarding_summary: Make the first successful product action clear and executable for the intended audience
growth_playbook_onboarding_question_1: What does first value look like for this audience?
growth_playbook_onboarding_question_2: Which setup step can be removed, reordered or explained with real product context?
growth_playbook_onboarding_question_3: Which guardrail catches a faster path that attracts the wrong users?
growth_playbook_onboarding_guardrail_1: Do not hide important limits, costs or permissions.
growth_playbook_onboarding_guardrail_2: A shorter flow is a hypothesis, not proof of activation lift.
growth_playbook_pricing_focus: Explore packaging without inventing market facts
growth_playbook_pricing_summary: Frame reversible pricing and packaging hypotheses from product value and explicit user constraints
growth_playbook_pricing_question_1: Which capability or outcome is being packaged, and for whom?
growth_playbook_pricing_question_2: What willingness-to-pay evidence is actually available?
growth_playbook_pricing_question_3: What experiment can run without mutating live billing?
growth_playbook_pricing_guardrail_1: Never change live prices, billing or entitlements automatically.
growth_playbook_pricing_guardrail_2: Mark market assumptions as untested and request user evidence.
growth_playbook_launch_summary: Turn a real product change into launch assets that fit a channel and make the next action clear
growth_playbook_launch_question_1: What changed, who benefits and where can it be verified?
growth_playbook_launch_question_2: Which channel's norms and audience are in scope?
growth_playbook_launch_question_3: What should a reader do next without being pressured?
growth_playbook_launch_output_3: Reply and support questions to monitor
growth_playbook_launch_guardrail_1: No mass unsolicited outreach, fake scarcity or fabricated traction.
growth_playbook_launch_guardrail_2: Drafts never post, email or publish without explicit user action.
growth_playbook_evaluator_focus: Apply a stable rubric to every candidate
growth_playbook_evaluator_summary: Check implementation quality and evidence with separate, visible inputs instead of a magic score
growth_playbook_evaluator_question_1: Which deterministic checks and rubric dimensions apply?
growth_playbook_evaluator_question_2: Can another reviewer reproduce every score from recorded inputs?
growth_playbook_evaluator_question_3: Which limitation prevents this from being called a measured outcome?
growth_playbook_evaluator_output_2: Observed checks and estimated rubric notes
growth_playbook_evaluator_guardrail_1: The evaluator must not silently reward its own proposal.
growth_playbook_evaluator_guardrail_2: Never label a candidate Winner without a defined outcome evaluation.
growth_playbook_skeptic_focus: Try to falsify the growth claim
growth_playbook_skeptic_summary: Look for missing evidence, alternative explanations and unsafe implementation assumptions before a decision
growth_playbook_skeptic_question_1: What observation would disconfirm the proposed mechanism?
growth_playbook_skeptic_question_2: Which segment, guardrail or time window is missing?
growth_playbook_skeptic_question_3: Could the change improve a proxy while harming the intended outcome?
growth_playbook_skeptic_guardrail_1: Keep uncertainty visible instead of converting it into a score.
growth_playbook_skeptic_guardrail_2: Do not access private customer data or bypass product permissions.
growth_playbook_review_next_step: Review the {focus} outputs, add evidence, then decide whether to prepare a bounded experiment.
growth_rubric_calculation_seo: 100-point structural rubric: title 20, description 20, headings 20, language 10, useful copy 15, canonical 5, links 5 and image descriptions 5.
growth_rubric_calculation_quality: 30-point structural hint set: mobile viewport 5, named controls 10, form labels 5, loading hints 5 and claim guardrails 5.
growth_rubric_calculation_accessibility: 100-point source-structure review: language 15, landmarks 15, heading hierarchy 20, image alternatives 15, named controls 20 and form labels 15. It is a transparent prompt for follow-up testing, not a WCAG or assistive-technology score.
growth_rubric_calculation_render: 20-point observed static-render review: viewport coverage 8, horizontal overflow 6, visible copy 4 and capture metadata 2. It summarizes local Chromium inspection and never infers performance, accessibility or growth lift.
growth_rubric_calculation_performance: 20-point observed browser-timing review: first contentful paint 8, DOM content loaded 4, load complete 4 and timing metadata integrity 4. Thresholds are local hints and do not represent Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals or real-user performance.
growth_rubric_recommendation_title: Add one descriptive <title> between 10 and 60 characters.
growth_rubric_recommendation_description: Add a useful meta description between 70 and 160 characters.
growth_rubric_recommendation_headings: Use one clear <h1> and at least one supporting <h2>.
growth_rubric_recommendation_language: Declare the document language with an html lang attribute.
growth_rubric_recommendation_content: Add more visible, product-specific copy that explains the page.
growth_rubric_recommendation_canonical: Add a canonical link with a stable, non-empty URL.
growth_rubric_recommendation_links: Add at least one useful link to the next reader action.
growth_rubric_recommendation_media: Give every image a concise, useful alt attribute.
growth_rubric_recommendation_viewport: Add a viewport declaration so narrow screens get an intentional layout.
growth_rubric_recommendation_controls: Give every link and button visible text or an explicit accessible name.
growth_rubric_recommendation_forms: Associate each form control with a visible label or an accessible name.
growth_rubric_recommendation_loading: Review external styles and parser-blocking scripts; confirm timing in a real browser.
growth_rubric_recommendation_claims: Replace absolute growth or winner language with a specific, evidenced claim.
growth_rubric_recommendation_landmarks: Provide one main landmark and label each navigation landmark.
growth_rubric_recommendation_images: Add an alt attribute to every image, using empty text only for decorative images.
growth_rubric_recommendation_render_capt: Run a fresh local Chromium capture for both 1280 × 900 desktop and 390 × 844 phone targets.
growth_rubric_recommendation_render_over: Inspect the overflowing elements at the affected viewport before shipping.
growth_rubric_recommendation_render_copy: Confirm that the page exposes meaningful visible copy in each captured viewport.
growth_rubric_recommendation_render_inte: Keep provenance and a limitation attached to every local render observation.
growth_rubric_recommendation_performance: Inspect blocking resources and first paint timing in the affected local capture.
Reduce parser-blocking work before the DOM becomes ready.
Inspect local resource loading and defer non-essential work.
Keep complete observed timing metadata and limitations for both viewports.
growth_rubric_limitation_seo_html: This reviews the archived HTML only; it does not crawl, index, rank or measure traffic.
growth_rubric_limitation_seo_scores: Scores are estimated structural signals, not a predicted position or conversion result.
growth_rubric_limitation_seo_external: External links, search demand, backlinks, structured data and real user behavior are not evaluated here.
growth_rubric_limitation_quality_html: This inspects archived HTML only; it does not run Lighthouse, a browser timing trace or a screen reader.
growth_rubric_limitation_quality_hint: A strong hint is not an accessibility certification, Core Web Vital or performance result.
growth_rubric_limitation_quality_review: Review the rendered page on supported devices and run dedicated accessibility and performance tools before shipping.
growth_rubric_limitation_accessibility_h: This inspects archived HTML only; it does not run a browser, keyboard path, screen reader or automated axe/WCAG audit.
growth_rubric_limitation_accessibility_c: Color contrast, focus visibility, dynamic announcements, target size, timing and interaction semantics are not established by these hints.
growth_rubric_limitation_accessibility_r: Review the rendered page with keyboard and assistive technology before shipping; the estimate does not prove accessibility or conversion lift.
growth_rubric_limitation_render_capture: The check covers one sanitized static document in the locally installed Chromium build; it is not a Lighthouse score, Core Web Vital or real-user performance measurement.
growth_rubric_limitation_render_png: PNG dimensions are validated separately; browser layout floors can make a requested phone width a covered minimum rather than an exact CSS layout width.
growth_rubric_limitation_render_comparis: No screenshot comparison, screen-reader run, interaction test, network waterfall or growth outcome is included.
growth_rubric_limitation_performance_tim: Timings come from one sanitized static document in the locally installed Chromium build; when file:// does not expose a paint entry, the first-paint value is a first rendered frame proxy. They are not field data or a Core Web Vital.
growth_rubric_limitation_performance_thr: The thresholds are heuristic and do not account for network conditions, device diversity, CPU contention or repeat-view caching.
growth_rubric_limitation_performance_too: No Lighthouse audit, accessibility audit, visual regression comparison or growth outcome is included.
